def factor_adx_linear_momentum(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    prev_close = close.shift(1)
    tr1 = high - low
    tr2 = (high - prev_close).abs()
    tr3 = (low - prev_close).abs()
    tr = pd.concat([tr1, tr2, tr3], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    prev_high = high.shift(1)
    prev_low = low.shift(1)
    up_move = high - prev_high
    down_move = prev_low - low
    plus_dm = np.where((up_move > down_move) & (up_move > 0), up_move, 0.0)
    minus_dm = np.where((down_move > up_move) & (down_move > 0), down_move, 0.0)
    period = 14
    alpha = 1.0 / period
    atr = tr.ewm(alpha=alpha, adjust=False, min_periods=period).mean()
    smoothed_plus_dm = pd.Series(plus_dm, index=df_copy.index).ewm(alpha=alpha, adjust=False, min_periods=period).mean()
    smoothed_minus_dm = pd.Series(minus_dm, index=df_copy.index).ewm(alpha=alpha, adjust=False, min_periods=period).mean()
    plus_di = 100.0 * smoothed_plus_dm / atr.replace(0, np.nan)
    minus_di = 100.0 * smoothed_minus_dm / atr.replace(0, np.nan)
    dx = 100.0 * np.abs(plus_di - minus_di) / (plus_di + minus_di).replace(0, np.nan)
    adx = dx.ewm(alpha=alpha, adjust=False, min_periods=period).mean()
    sma50 = close.rolling(50, min_periods=50).mean()
    pct_diff = (close - sma50) / sma50
    blend = np.clip((adx - 15) / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    factor = (2.0 * blend - 1.0) * pct_diff
    df_copy["factor_adx_linear_momentum"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_adx_linear_momentum"]
description: Crossover of elite trend-regime momentum (parent1) and qualified smooth momentum (parent2). Primary mechanism from parent1: dual signal (trend when ADX high, mean-reversion when ADX low). Borrows the continuous regime gate concept from parent2, replacing the hard ADX>20 threshold with a linear blend over ADX 15-25. This smooths the transition, reducing signal flipping and aiming to improve ICIR while preserving the parent's strong rank-order stability (parent strength: high RankIC). The child keeps raw signal without cross-sectional transform, following both parents.
